senses.gloss: m.(b. h. קַרְסֻלּ־; v. preced.)bent, joint, ankle. Ohol. I, 8 עשרה בק׳ Ar. (ed. בקוּרְסֵל) ten joints are in the ankle.—Du. קַרְסוּלַּיִם; pl. קַרְסוּלִּים, קַרְסוּלִּין.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:25">Tosef. Ḥull. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 4:25">IV</cite>), 25 <he>כל שיש לו ארבע … וק׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>וקרסוליו</he>, read: <he>לין …</he>) locusts which have four wings and jointed legs (hindlegs for leaping); <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:7">Ḥull. III, 7</cite> (Bab. ed. 59ᵃ <cite ref="S02077"><he>קרצ׳</he></cite>; Ms. M. <he>קרסולין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); ib. 65ᵇ Ms. R. 2 a. Ar. (ed. <cite ref="S02077"><he>קרצ׳</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9).

<cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 3:3">Tosef. Succ. III, 3</cite> (ref. to <he>אפסים</he>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 47:3">Ez. XLVII, 3</cite>) <he>עד קַרְצוּלָּיו</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>קרס׳</he>) up to the ankles; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:2:3">Y. Shek. VI, 50ᵃ</cite> top <he>עד קַרְסוּלָּה</he> (Chald.).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">Gen. R. s. 32</cite> <he>אלולי … קַרְסוּלָּיו וכ׳</he> but for the water coming up to his ankles, he would not have gone into the ark.
<cite ref="Ketubot 111b:23">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>והלכתי עד קַרְסוּלַּי וכ׳</he> I waded up to my ankles in honey that had dropped from dates.
Koh. R. to XII, 5 החגב אלו קרסוליו ‘the hagab’ (locust, ib.), that is his ankles (legs, v. supra); Lev. R. s. 18 השקד אילין קַרְסוּלּוֹת (corr. acc.).
